units.source_text: 小姐照例不发一语，源氏公子似觉自己也说不出话来了。

en.t: As usual, the young lady did not say a word, and Prince Genji seemed to feel that he himself could no longer speak either.

units.source_text: 然而他总想试试看，是否能够打破她向来的沉默，便对她讲各种各样的话。

en.t: Still, he kept wanting to try to see whether he could break her habitual silence, so he spoke to her about all sorts of things.

units.source_text: 可是小姐非常怕羞，一言不答，只将衣袖遮住了口。

en.t: But the young lady was terribly shy and gave no answer at all, only covering her mouth with her sleeve.

units.source_text: 但这姿态也表现得十分笨拙，不合时尚，两肘高高抬起，

en.t: Yet even this gesture looked very awkward and unfashionable, with both elbows raised high,

units.source_text: 好像司仪官威风凛凛列队行走时的架势，

en.t: rather like the posture of masters of ceremony marching in a dignified procession,

units.source_text: 可是脸上又带着微笑，这就显得更不调和。

en.t: and yet there was a smile on her face, which made the whole effect seem even more out of harmony.

units.source_text: 源氏公子心甚不快，很想早些儿离去，就对她说：“

en.t: Prince Genji felt deeply displeased and wanted very much to leave soon, so he said to her, "

units.source_text: 我看你孤单无援，所以一见之后便怜爱你。

en.t: When I saw that you were alone and without anyone to rely on, I felt tenderness for you from the moment I met you.

units.source_text: 你不可将我当作外人，应该亲近我，我才高兴照顾你。

en.t: You must not treat me as a stranger; you should draw close to me, and then I will gladly look after you.

units.source_text: 如今你一味疏远我，教我好生不快！”

en.t: Now you do nothing but keep your distance from me, and it makes me very unhappy!"

units.source_text: 便以此为借口，即景吟诗道：

en.t: Taking this as his pretext, he composed a poem on the scene and recited:
